# THE IMAGEGEN DOWNLOAD MANIFEST. One row per FILE a tier needs, pinned by
# repository REVISION (a commit, never a branch), sha256 and byte size.
# Read by crates/tillandsias-headless/src/imagegen_models.rs; no interpreter.
# Files are fetched on first use into cache_root()/models/imagegen/<tier>/
# through the enclave proxy only, sha256-verified on the host before they are
# kept. A digest mismatch discards the file. Formats: .safetensors or .gguf
# only (a pickle checkpoint can execute code on load).
# Licences re-verified 2026-10-29 on the Hugging Face API (cardData.license,
# gated) for the pinned revision:
#   akleine/sdxs-09          openrail++  gated=false  (the single-file SDXS-512-0.9
#                            sd.cpp's docs/distilled_sd.md names; sha256 equals the
#                            sdxs09 file measured on lenovinha and yoga 2026-10-27)
#   ByteDance/SDXL-Lightning openrail++  gated=false
#   madebyollin/sdxl-vae-fp16-fix  mit  gated=false
# I2/I3 (FLUX.1-schnell) rows are NOT here: their upstream repo is gated and
# 1921-qqfz repoints them at an ungated Apache-2.0 GGUF copy; it adds their
# rows to this file. A tier with no row here cannot be fetched.
# Columns:
#   tier      I0..I3, a row of tiers.tsv
#   role      model | vae | clip_l | t5xxl  (the sd.cpp flag the file is passed as)
#   repo      Hugging Face repository
#   revision  pinned commit sha
#   file      path inside the repository (also the cached file name's basename)
#   sha256    pinned digest
#   bytes     exact size
#   licence   licence id (tiers.tsv PERMISSIVE_LICENCES)
#tier
